---
title: "Contributors and acknowledgements"
---

The Guide for the Integration of Climate Data in Electricity System Planning and Design was developed collaboratively by climate scientists, energy-sector specialists, and practitioners. Contributions included original writing, scientific and technical input, editorial integration, information architecture, tool development, project coordination, and feedback on draft material.

Because the guide was developed iteratively, contributions varied in nature and scope. Authors of individual pages are identified on those pages where authorship can be reliably established.

## Project leadership

**Principal Investigator:** Paulin Coulibaly, McMaster University

## Consultation participants

The guide benefited from comments, technical feedback, and practical insights provided through meetings, workshops and informal reviews during its development. Because feedback was collected iteratively and through several collaborative processes, it is not possible to attribute all comments to particular pages or identify every individual contribution. We gratefully acknowledge the collective input of energy-sector practitioners who participated in this process over the course of the project. These contributions helped improve the guide’s scientific accuracy, practical relevance, organization, and clarity.
